Browse folders of Rhino `.3dm` files as thumbnails and open any model in a 3D view to rotate and measure it. No Rhino install or license needed.

**Install:** download `Rhino3dmViewer-win-x64.zip` below, unzip it anywhere and run `RhinoThumbs.NET.exe`. Keep the other files from the zip next to it. Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit; nothing else to install.

Windows may show a SmartScreen warning the first time because the app is not code-signed: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

See the [README](https://github.com/kartikddoshi/Rhino3dmViewer#readme) for features and troubleshooting.
